## Phase

Research — not promised

## Question

Can we select a game source and automatically list every HUD element with no user marks and no movement prompt?

## Why it matters

That was the original “I imagine something along the lines of selecting a source and analyzing the view” idea. It is also the easiest thing to over-promise.

## Honest stance

Unsupervised full-frame HUD discovery across arbitrary games is a research problem (menus are 100% UI, diegetic holograms, translucent chrome, resolution/HUD-scale settings). We should **not** schedule it as a feature until:

1. HUD Mask source + PNG parity ships
2. Presence works on NTE
3. Mark-and-snap works
4. Movement-proposal has been spiked

A successful spike here is a written decision: proceed, or **wontfix** and keep user-guided automation.

## Done when

- [ ] A short note in `docs/feasibility.md` is updated with the spike result
- [ ] If it works at all, it is only as a proposer that still requires confirm
- [ ] It is not on the MVP or v1 board
